samples.text_head: Half-Yearly Results | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Half-Yearly Results AI Summary Close X AEW UK REIT reported NAV of £170.50m (107.45pps) as at 30 September 2026, a 0.86% six-month decline but a NAV total return of 2.84% and shareholder total return of 8.08%; profit before tax was £4.88m (EPS 3.07pps) and EPRA EPS 3.67pps. The board declared total dividends of 4.00pps for the period, maintaining a 2p quarterly payout for the 44th consecutive quarter. Portfolio valuation was £214.02m across 33 properties with EPRA NIY 7.43% and EPRA vacancy 9.37%. Financial gearing is 25.42% of GAV with a £60.0m facility maturing July 2027, cash £13.51m and a £30m SONIA cap at 4.064%. Net Asset Value(s) | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Net Asset Value(s) AI Summary Close X City of London Investment Trust reports net asset values at close of business on 25 November 2026: NAV including current financial year revenue 558.0p per share (debt at fair value 564.1p) and NAV excluding current financial year revenue 555.6p per share (debt at fair value 561.7p). All calculations use AIC methodology, and the Company states debt marked at fair value is its estimate of senior secured notes using discount rates derived from relevant UK gilt redemption yields plus credit spreads (applied daily and updated monthly, with specific spreads for the 4.53% 2029, 2.67% 2046 and 2.94% 2049 notes).
